entities.name: Scientific Method
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A systematic approach to acquiring knowledge through observation, hypothesis formation, experimentation, and falsification. Codified by Francis Bacon and Galileo, refined by Popper's falsificationism, the scientific method is the most successful epistemic framework in human history, enabling the technological transformation of civilization.
